items: 【2500W Pressurized Steam Cleaner】 Our handheld steam cleaner is powered by a 2500W motor producing 3BAR pressurized steam at 221°F/105°C in 15 seconds. Delivers a instant, high-temperature steam that penetrates deep into surfaces. Effortlessly dissolves tough kitchen grease, bathroom grime, and upholstery stains without chemicals. Save time and money with professional-grade deep cleaning results at home

【Large 1.4L Tank for Continuous Cleaning】Features a 1.4L/47.3oz heat-resistant ABS tank with hot-fill capability,this steam cleaner delivers 60 minutes of continuous pressurized steam without cooling interruptions.Clean your entire home,floors,tiles,upholstery,and car interior in one session. Chemical-free steam ensures a safe environment for kids and pets while saving you time and effort

【Smart 3-Level Steam Control】The steam cleaner for home features ergonomic handle with trigger switch and 3 adjustable steam levels.Instantly control steam power from low to high without interrupting cleaning.Perfectly clean delicate curtains,tough tile grout,and all surfaces between with customized steam power. Enjoy seamless, professional results without bending or stopping your workflow

【100% Chemical-Free & Family-Safe Cleaning】This multipurpose steamer cleaning uses only water to produce 221°F steam with no chemicals.Naturally blast away dust, and allergens from surfaces. Safely for children's items, pet areas, and whole home without harmful fumes. Ideal for families with allergies, creating a healthier living environment with chemical-free cleaning

【Complete 21-Piece Steam Cleaning Kit】Designed with a lightweight and portable, extra-long 78" power cord, and 78" steam hose,includes 21 accessories (brushes, scrapers, nozzles) with storage case.Delivers extended reach and specialized tools for all surfaces and areas. Move seamlessly through kitchens, bathrooms, living rooms, and car interiors without unplugging. The all-in-one storage case organizes everything compactly for professional cleaning results anywhere
